profile.headline: Software engineer at CNN
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with a strong product mindset, experienced in building scalable, user-focused solutions across industries like media, finance, and technology. At CNN (Warner Bros. Discovery), I develop and optimize ad delivery platforms that power millions of global user experiences — from designing dynamic placement systems to launching premium sponsorship features like Focus Mode.

I thrive at the intersection of technology and strategy — translating complex requirements into elegant, data-driven solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and performance constraints. My background spans full-stack development (React, Node.js, AWS), agile product delivery, and cross-functional collaboration with designers, product managers, and stakeholders.

Passionate about continuous improvement, I bring a detail-oriented approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a curiosity for exploring how technology drives value and innovation. Whether leading a sprint or designing user journeys, I focus on delivering measurable outcomes and seamless user experiences.

Languages: JavaScript, Python, Ruby
Frameworks: React.js, Redux.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Served as the primary technical liaison between technical teams and revenue leadership to ensure
operational clarity and alignment on strategic initiatives.
- Proactively monitored platform health metrics and compliance trends to support leadership
decision-making and mitigate technical risks.
- Led the technical coordination for a premium sponsorship initiative, aligning Product and Ad Operations to execute a high-visibility revenue program.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Working as a Fullstack developer on the ServiceNet team to enhance and ensure the quality of MassMutual’s redesigned APIs and internal web applications.
- Implemented several vital components that contributed to MassMutual’s successful migration from their legacy ServiceNet app to a modernized version using React, Spring, Kafka, and AWS. 
- Led and delivered initiative that enables agents to submit claims digitally, significantly streamlining involvements in claim workflows.
- Migrated loan payoff recalculation functionality using SOAP API services to a microservices-based REST API application, optimizing loan management capabilities.
- Collaborate with QA Automation to add QA-specific attributes to increase testability and reduce the flakiness of their UI automated tests. 
- Participate in on-call meetings to help triage, debug, and resolve production issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Owned, enhanced, and supported Chase’s payment authorization solution for streaming services built using React and Spring Boot.
- Performed comprehensive testing of payment authorization functionalities before each release. 
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including offshore, QA, System Analysts, and Business stakeholders.
- Created Springboot web services that efficiently consumed data from various microservices in JSON format, streamlining data integration and user response management. 
- Assisted with product demos and participated in sprint ceremonies following SAFE agile methodology

positions.title: Software Engineer Apprentice
positions.description:
- Successfully contributed to an established, mono-repo codebase, with a CI/CD pipeline to ship features to employees and customers
- Effectively communicated and worked remotely with a team of 10 including engineers, designers, and product managers to develop a self-reporting bug ticketing tool in its entirety
- Utilized React and Typescript to develop an end-to-end ticketing tool that provided direct bug reporting capabilities to over 100 employees

positions.title: Jr. Performace Designer
positions.description:
- Analyzed and implemented the requirements needed to communicate the message of the product on kindness and learning to produce 20 different lesson plans
- Reviewed project deliverables and attended walkthrough meetings to gain an understanding of the features to be implemented.
- Demoed product implementations to investors and product managers at the end of each release cycle

positions.title: Student
positions.description: 15-week intensive software engineering boot-camp where I learned Ruby on Rails, JavaScript and React

positions.title: Job Developer
positions.description:
- Built a network of over 30 business relations to assist young adults with procuring employment and internship opportunities over the span of 6 months
- Managed internship program which included processing payroll, conducting interviews and orientations for 80 students per year

positions.title: Community Psychiatric Supports and Services (CPST)
positions.description:
- Assisted children with serious emotional/behavioral disorders reach their goals on their individualized education plan, IEP, by providing in-home counseling sessions
- Educated my caseload of 15 children yearly on multiple coping mechanisms through in-home activities, deep-rooted conversations, travel training and academic tutoring sessions

positions.title: Job Coach
positions.description: Supported onsite  and offsite  job training, conducted  work site  visits  to ensure  a  positive  relationship between employer and individuals, and helped resolve  worksite  problems.
